title: ConversationOverviewRail replacement test is misnamed and leaves useDeferredValue deferral untested
outcome:
The test replacing the four deleted composer-focus-freeze tests is named 'updates the projection as messages change, without freezing on composer focus' but never creates or focuses a composer textarea. Nothing in it would fail if the composer-focus freeze were reinstated.

Deleting the four useComposerPromptFocused tests is correct (the code is gone), but the risk they guarded — the rail's O(N) rebuild janking composer input — is now the ENTIRE justification for useDeferredValue, and it has zero coverage. Note RTL's rerender is act()-wrapped so deferred work flushes synchronously; assertions of this shape cannot distinguish deferred from non-deferred rendering.

Action: rename the test to what it actually asserts, and add coverage that genuinely pins the deferral behaviour.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1b, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-OBSOLETE. The misnamed test no longer exists on master f7db2c58 (grep).
